items.summary: Phil Foden delivered a sensational hat-trick performance in Manchester City's 5-1 Champions League victory over AEK Athens, becoming the third Englishman to score a hat-trick and assist a goal in a Champions League match.

source.title: Foden 'going in the right direction' after Champions League hat-trick

items.summary: Antoine Semenyo faces an eight-week spell on the sidelines after sustaining a knee injury during the 3-2 Premier League win over Ipswich Town, leaving Enzo Maresca searching for attacking alternatives.

source.title: Semenyo out for eight weeks but Maresca has no regrets over forward's gametime

items.summary: Off the pitch, the Independent Football Regulator has warned they possess absolute power to force Manchester City's owners to sell the club following the guilty verdict for financial misconduct, with a swingeing points deduction that could guarantee relegation being reported as the most likely punishment.

source.title: ‘Absolute Power’—The Ultimate Threat Hanging Over Man City Revealed
